notes: Creativity: 8K panels and naked-eye 3D displays are marketed partly for 'content creation', but they are general display components sold to OEMs, so they were not counted as creative tools. InnoGallery promotion is described as expanding in 2026; its current commercial scale is undisclosed. Board approved a 2025 donation to an 'Indigenous Creativity Education Foundation' (called 'Indigenous Innovation Education Foundation' in the audit committee table); the name is inconsistent and its execution is not stated, so it was not scored. The Christmas program's 10,721 children appears to be cumulative over 9 years. Disability employment accommodation and maternity and breastfeeding facilities are described only in general terms. 'Creation leave' and volunteer leave are described as introduced from 2025. Aerospace display products are aimed at cockpits of fighters and attack helicopters. These are military display components, not weapons manufacturing as described, so they were not flagged; the team may wish to review. The labor-dispute disclosure (4.5.2) is truncated in the provided text, so no losses or findings could be verified. 30 whistleblowing reports are listed with no outcomes, and no substantiated cases are disclosed.
